description: Literature anchor rates and inventories used across the models. Units noted per entry. Sources are cited by name only (no links) by project policy.

entries.name: water_unbaked_metal_1_over_t
entries.value: q ~ 3e-9/t[h] mbar.L/s/cm2 (2.2e-9 torr units at 1 h)
entries.source: Chiggiato, CERN Accelerator School lecture notes on outgassing (2017); Grinham & Chew, Appl. Sci. Converg. Technol. 26(5), 95 (2017)

entries.name: water_desorption_energy_window
entries.source: Redhead JVST A 13,467 (1995); Li & Dylla JVST A 11,1702 (1993); Chiggiato, CERN Yellow Rep., arXiv:2006.07124

entries.name: monolayer_conversion
entries.value: 1e15 molecules/cm2 = 3.05e-5 torr.L/cm2 at 295 K; 1 mg H2O = 1.02 torr.L

entries.name: H2_baked_steel
entries.value: 3e-12 mbar.L/s/cm2 after 150C x 24 h; band used 1e-13..3e-12 torr units
entries.source: Chiggiato, CERN Accelerator School lecture notes on outgassing (2017)

entries.name: CH4_steel
entries.value: ~1e-15 torr.L/s/cm2 (rough, ~decade uncertainty) - sets gettered EOL ceiling
entries.source: project inference bounded by 10-yr-class field life; see vacuum_degradation_sources.md

entries.name: epoxy_water_diffusivity
entries.source: epoxy moisture literature incl. dual-stage studies (Microelectron. Reliab. 2019 S0026271419311771; IEEE ECTC 2008 4525009)

entries.name: outgassing_share_of_gas_load
entries.value: ~90% of total gas load in high-vacuum systems; 75-95% water near 1e-3 mbar
entries.source: Grinham & Chew, Appl. Sci. Converg. Technol. 26(5), 95 (2017)

entries.name: getter_capacities_St707
entries.value: H2 ~170 torr.L/g saturation (225 std cc/g); H2O ~2.4 torr.L/g (est.); activation ~400C x 45 min
entries.source: Sandia National Labs St707 getter data report 105402 (via the UChicago PSEC getter library); UChicago PSEC getter note on St707 H2O monolayer capacity

entries.name: ice_optics_budget
entries.value: IR ice bands 3.16/4.6/6.1/13 um; ~0.1 um on cold filter measurable; ~1 um severe at 3.0-3.1 um

entries.name: epoxy_offgas_composition
entries.value: water-dominated at <=100 C (ASTM E595 reports WVR separately); organics minor (CVCM species); CO2 small; CO not from glue at low T
entries.source: ASTM E595 framework; Master Bond low-outgassing guide; JVST B epoxy TD-GC study (title-verified, paywalled)
